text: Reed and Lumen chase basil, seedlings, and Mrs. Elara's pale tomatoes, while Lumen's sharing-circle and tea-gathering ideas get shot down by Flint and Dusk as soft distractions again. Vale flips the fix-it list once more, now ranking the water pump above even the press seals, and bails on Lumen's wildflowers to join the grease crew at the Yard. Flint keeps grinding on hard repairs and requisition forms, refusing to soften up, while Dusk keeps insisting the whole city's uneasy "tremor" is one big hidden system failure nobody wants to face. Garden-versus-grease stays split down the middle, with 0900 hours still the moment everyone collides.
